products.name: AquaFlow Fountain
products.short: Water fountain for cats and small dogs with a carbon filter and a quiet low-voltage pump.
products.description: Holds 2.5 litres of water and keeps it moving through a replaceable carbon filter. Part of the PawPantry Pro range; the warranty terms are on our Product Warranty page. Care and filter changes are explained in our care guide.

products.name: AquaFlow Replacement Filters (4-pack)
products.short: Four carbon filters for the AquaFlow Fountain.
products.description: Fits the AquaFlow Fountain only. How often to change the filter depends on the number of pets; see the care guide.

products.name: SmartBowl Feeder
products.short: Automatic feeder for dry food, up to 6 meals a day.
products.description: Dispenses dry food on a schedule of up to 6 meals a day, in portions of 5 g to 120 g. The hopper holds 4 litres, about 1.6 kg of kibble. Part of the PawPantry Pro range; the warranty terms are on our Product Warranty page.

products.name: ComfortHeat Heated Pet Bed
products.short: Low-voltage heated bed with a washable cover, medium size.
products.description: Part of the PawPantry Pro range; the warranty terms are on our Product Warranty page. The cover comes off and can be washed at 30 °C.

products.name: PawPantry Kitchen Adult Dog, Chicken & Rice 3 kg
products.short: Complete dry food for adult dogs, chicken and rice.
products.description: Complete food for adult dogs of all sizes. Made in France. Daily amounts by weight are in our feeding guide.

products.name: PawPantry Kitchen Adult Dog, Chicken & Rice 12 kg
products.short: Complete dry food for adult dogs, chicken and rice, large bag.
products.description: The same recipe as the 3 kg bag in a 12 kg bag. Made in France.

products.name: PawPantry Kitchen Adult Cat, Salmon 2 kg
products.short: Complete dry food for adult cats, with salmon.
products.description: Complete food for adult cats. Made in France.

products.name: PawPantry Kitchen Puppy 3 kg
products.description: Growth formula for puppies. Follow the table printed on the bag. Made in France.

products.name: PawPantry Kitchen Kitten 1.5 kg
products.description: Growth formula for kittens. Follow the table printed on the bag. Made in France.
